metadata.description: A sanctuary for stray bits - plugins that wandered in and found purpose

plugins.name: commonplace
plugins.description: A knowledge vault Claude reads and keeps for any folder of notes: graph-indexed vault tools, private domains that stay sealed, connections to what you already wrote surfaced under answers, and [[note]] links in replies that are checked against the vault.

plugins.name: strata
plugins.description: Entropy-guided structural outlines for Claude Code — compresses large file reads by ~83% without parsing, using BSP trees and Shannon entropy to serve navigable file maps instead of full content

plugins.name: agent-peer
plugins.description: Daemonless local messaging between Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
